PART I

Item 1. Business

Acme Widgets designs and sells industrial widgets & gadgets to manufacturers in North America. The company was founded in 1990 and sells through distributors and a direct sales force. Widgets are sold under multi-year supply agreements; gadgets are sold through catalog orders. Acme operates two plants and employs about 400 people.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Demand for widgets depends on manufacturing capital spending, which is cyclical. A downturn could reduce orders and pricing. Steel is the main input and its price is volatile. Three customers account for a large share of sales, and losing one could hurt results materially.

PART II

Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations

Revenue grew to $120.0 million in 2024 from $95.0 million in 2023, as restated. Operating margin stayed < 15% because steel costs rose. Cash ended the year at $55.0 million and total debt at $25.0 million.
